name: Collect-A-Con Atlanta
blurb: Atlanta stop of the multi-city Collect-A-Con tour: trading cards, pop-culture collectibles, cosplay and celebrity autograph signings at the Georgia World Congress Center.
notes: Collect-A-Con runs Atlanta twice a year. The live city page (/atlanta-2/) still shows the most recent show, 'Atlanta 2' on Sept 26-27, 2026 at the Georgia World Congress Center Hall A1, which ended before this research window opens (2026-10-05); its countdown has expired and no next date is shown. Checked the site's XML sitemap for any schedule/tour page or 2027-dated URL across the whole domain and found none, so no Atlanta edition is announced yet for 2027. Cover uses this page's own branded key art (og image).
